Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. WriteContentSequence consumes actual borrowed StringPair fields through AttributeList/SAX events without host pair reconstruction. ZipStorage supplies the original three-slot stream manifest including empty Version. CALC-494/WRITER425 preserve unchanged right output at leading/trailing token boundaries. Actual XStorage/XRelationshipAccess/XWriter services, host relationship output and complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain pending. Native parseContentType application uses initialized StringPair rows, ordered defaults then explicit overrides, case-sensitive short-name suffixes, last duplicate assignment and hidden internal content metadata. Missing/broken content metadata and malformed own relationships refuse stream opening. Async initialization caches only immutable fields or an error diagnostic, never a shared owned UNO exception; concurrent/repeated failed opens create/destroy their own exceptions. Both close methods only reset the cursor (CALC-496/WRITER427), without a corrective disconnected flag.
